recordStage: Investigation snapshot before release preparation; commit and publication status below describe that snapshot.
scope: YOLO classification dependency failure in the released Windows Designer

releaseInspection.method: ZIP member inspection and PyInstaller CArchiveReader embedded PYZ inspection; executable not run

rootCause: Spec-level collect_submodules runs before Analysis applies --paths. The source package is unavailable to the collector. Classification Python files are copied as data, but their Pillow dependency is not analyzed or bundled.

collectorComparison.fix: Make existing --paths/-p entries available in the PyInstaller child process PYTHONPATH before spec collectors run; preserve inherited PYTHONPATH and parent environment.
collectorComparison.regression: A temporary external classification plugin is collected and the real PyInstaller modulegraph resolves PIL.Image.

applicationFixes: Classification import errors identify onnxruntime or Pillow and preserve the underlying exception type and message.
Designer and Runtime package self-tests run an embedded input-dependent classification ONNX model through Pillow preprocessing and CPU inference.
Both windowed executable entries supply missing stdout/stderr before freeze_support; worker job.failed reporting remains unchanged.

diagnosticRegressionBeforeFix.reason: Old combined error message discards the actual import failure.

validation.initialPackagerBrandingInvocation: FAILED to import branding_fixtures when invoked by module name; corrected unittest discovery invocation passed. This was a test invocation error, not a business assertion failure.

notRun: Rebuilt frozen EXE and installer validation
releaseFollowUp: Build and verify new packages using both the application fixes and the fixed packager. The application release workflow still pins packager 3ef28d7f581dfff09fc900ba64df34b275cc1dcd; no release, workflow pin, installed application, or field project was changed.
